memberdef.name: ISOTP_PCI_TYPE_SHIFT
memberdef.initializer: 4U /* frame type is the high nibble of byte 0 */

memberdef.name: ISOTP_LOW_NIBBLE
memberdef.initializer: 0x0FU /* SF_DL, FF_DL high bits, SN and FS */

memberdef.name: ISOTP_FF_SHORT_OFFSET
memberdef.initializer: 2U /* first payload byte with the 12-bit FF_DL */

memberdef.name: ISOTP_FF_ESCAPE_OFFSET
memberdef.initializer: 6U /* first payload byte with the 32-bit FF_DL */
